title: salvia viridis var. horminum
intro: Salvia viridis var. horminum, commonly known as Blue Sage, is a plant species in the mint family known for its distinct blue flowers. The health benefits of Salvia viridis var. horminum include its potential to alleviate anxiety, insomnia, and stress due to its adaptogenic properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils. These bioactive constituents contribute to its therapeutic potential in promoting relaxation, reducing inflammation, and protecting against oxidative stress.
